F-duck-drive-0003.name: Unnamed wetland 230 m SW of Goat River
F-duck-drive-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
F-duck-drive-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Goat River FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 3.5 ha, 20 m from the road.
About 3 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Goat River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 852 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-6: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).
Wolf: no closed season in MU 4-6 below 1,100 m (synopsis page 39 footnote, 90%: the Trench line is not mapped and "below 1,100 m" is my reading for both groups). VERIFY with the regional office.

seasonRows.notes: District 4. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 64 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 3 and 95 (Van Horne St S), Hwy 3 and 95, Hwy 3, Leadville Rd.

Walk: 30 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
